_about: Old Town Marketplace shop records. Public info only, read from oldtownmarketplace.com on 2026-11-17. Anything with a 'tbc' flag or unitConfirmed:false is a placeholder to check with management. One record per shop, same shape for every shop, so the records can feed the local-business app later.

hours.tbc: The home page says 11 to 7; the leasing page says 10 to 7.

bands.label: Top of the stairs, C units

spaces.name: Coming soon to B5
spaces.sells: The marketplace is turning B5 into a place to eat and sing, with karaoke on the cards. Details are still to come.

shops.name: Abuelita's Empanadas
shops.sells: Mirella and David have been baking empanadas here for ten years. Grab a seat in the dining room or order ahead for pickup.

shops.name: Colorado Dumplings
shops.sells: A dumpling cafe that shares the dining room with Abuelita's, so you can eat in comfort.

shops.name: Belle Isa Boutique
shops.sells: A boutique with exciting changes and new arrivals, so there is always something fresh on the racks.

shops.name: R&R Unique
shops.sells: Vinyl records, vintage t-shirts, books, memorabilia and collectibles spread across several units. It is new to the marketplace but not to Longmont.
shops.tbc: An older post also lists D4 for this shop, which is The Dinostaur's unit.

shops.name: High Society Smoke Shop
shops.sells: Hand-blown glass pipes, vaporizers, CBD, apparel, lighters and local jewelry, with friendly staff to help you find the right piece. Adults only.

shops.name: The Golden Bee
shops.sells: Local art, do-it-yourself workshops and a little retail therapy. The marketplace says exciting news is on the way.

shops.name: The Timi Collection
shops.sells: Vintage and second-hand clothing and accessories from the collection of Timi Dillon, a Longmont fashion icon. This is the shop she always wanted.

shops.name: The Happy Turtle Soap Shop
shops.sells: Small-batch soap, sea sponges, lotions, sea salt scrubs and bath salts. Everything is made with natural ingredients and extra virgin olive oil from Greece.

shops.name: Disorderly Designs
shops.sells: A shop on the main floor whose full story we still need to hear from the owner.
shops.tbc: What they sell is a placeholder until the owner tells us.

shops.name: Nirvana's Garden
shops.sells: A micro apothecary with herbal remedies, natural skincare and handmade goods, all chosen for clear ingredients and small makers. Find it by the east entry.

shops.name: Hail Mary Clothing
shops.sells: A clothing shop that the marketplace announced for June 2026 on the main floor.
shops.tbc: Opening and what they carry to confirm.

shops.name: The Dinostaur
shops.sells: A whole shop devoted to dinosaurs, up on the mezzanine in D4. You say the name like dahy-nuh-store.

shops.name: Broebuck Photography
shops.sells: A photography studio on the mezzanine level, ready for portraits and sessions.

shops.name: Proudly Addicted
shops.sells: A newer shop in the marketplace whose story we still need to hear.
shops.tbc: Unit and what they sell to confirm.

shops.name: Joyeria Maria Bonita
shops.sells: Rafael is a jeweler, videographer and DJ who specializes in Spanish music for weddings and quinceañeras. He has been at the marketplace since 2011.

shops.name: Great Nile Jewelry
shops.sells: Fine jewelry with an Egyptian inspiration. Come in and say hello to Ibrahim.

shops.name: Community Cares, Ltd.
shops.sells: A Longmont grassroots nonprofit that is having fun on purpose. It runs the Cars that Care Pine Car Derby and the Mariposas memorial.

shops.name: Obra Arts
shops.sells: The studio of Joyanna Rose Gittings, a two-time Shock Art winner who is painting a Diego Rivera tribute mural for the marketplace.

shops.name: The ART Spot
shops.sells: New Mexican retablos by santera Catherine Robles Shaw, old maps, Hopi silver, vintage masks and trade beads, and plenty of affordable gifts.

events.title: Cars that Care Pine Car Derby
events.tbc: The 2026 race date is still to be confirmed. Last year's race was the Saturday after Thanksgiving.
events.text: Kids and grown-ups race wooden cars down Main Street, and the car kits are free for registered racers. Community Cares runs it to raise money for neighbors in need.

events.title: Mariposas de la Memoria
events.text: Paper monarch butterflies hang from the foyer ceiling, each one a memorial with a QR code to a loved one's story. Donations go to El Comite de Longmont.

events.title: Baile de Tehuantepec Nuevo
events.tbc: Whether the mural is finished is still to confirm.
events.text: Joyanna Rose Gittings of Obra Arts is painting her own take on Diego Rivera's dance, with fiesta guests enjoying empanadas, boba and piñatas.

events.title: Shock Art public vote
events.tbc: The dates for next spring are still to be confirmed.
events.text: Longmont Art in Public Places shows the artists' models in the atrium, and you vote for the electric boxes that get painted around town.
